complete_examples.text: Based on this, a substructure coordination method based on penalty method, Lagrange multiplier method and elimination method is proposed to reduce the dimension of the dynamic matrices in the far-field ground vibration of railway system.

Lagrange multiplier method When the Lagrange multiplier method is adpoted to impose the contact constraint, the corresponding functional can be expressed as follows: J = M ̈XX + C ̇XX + 1 2KX2 −FX + 1 2λ(X1 b −X2 b), (A.7) where λ is the Lagrange multiplier, an undetermined independent variable.
